description: Where the data that are not commands go: a role per provider (raw, session, command port) and routes from one end to another (a provider's bytes, a tagged frame of a session, a stream, the board's code).

commands.label: Give a provider a role
commands.description: A provider carries raw bytes, a session or the commands of a command port; with no role it is not attached. The same again changes nothing; another role needs CLEAR_ROLE first.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The local provider's id

fields.label: Role
fields.description: data_matrix_role_e: Raw, Session or Commands

fields.label: Dead-man (ms)
fields.description: Session only: 0 none, else the silence that ends the session; 0 for the other roles

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: Session only: SYS_SESSION_SAFETY, the end of the session enters the safe state; 0 for the other roles

commands.label: Take a provider's role away
commands.description: Removes the provider's routes and its role; a session on it ends. The provider is not attached again.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The provider

commands.label: Add a route
commands.description: What comes out of the first end goes into the second. The same again changes nothing. A provider's end needs its role (Raw for the provider's bytes, Session for tagged data).

fields.label: From kind

fields.label: From b

commands.label: Remove a route
commands.description: Removes one route; one that is not there changes nothing.
